title: Xun Er's Scroll
summary: Xiao Yan's win over Yao Sheng puts him close to the top ten. Liu Qing then crushes the 11th-ranked student, an Eight-Star Dou Ling, with raw strength alone. Xiao Yan tells Xun Er he knows she hides her strength around him and wants to see her shine. That night she gives him a sealed Dou Skill scroll that he may only open once he is a Dou Wang, and warns him to keep the jade of Tuo She Gu Di secret. She then tells her guardian not to let anyone, not even her father, know about the gift. The next day 13 contestants remain and three random matches decide the last places. Yan Hao, with his Black Metal Hammer, beats Qian Mo and his Golden Sawtooth Disc. Zi Yan wins when Qin Zhen pretends to have an upset stomach, and Liu Qing is drawn against Xiao Yan.
events: Friends congratulate Xiao Yan; someone invites him back to the mountains for the Core Quenching Body Milk after the competition.
Liu Qing beats an Eight-Star Dou Ling without his spear.
Xiao Yan asks Xun Er to stop holding back her strength.
Xun Er gives Xiao Yan a sealed Dou Skill scroll for when he becomes a Dou Wang.
Zi Yan says she fought a Dou Huang class Magical Beast over a magical medicine.
Thirteen remain; three random matches decide the top ten.
Zi Yan wins by forfeit from Qin Zhen; Liu Qing is drawn against Xiao Yan.
